page.layout: One page of text in two faint columns at the left and centre of the scan, with a small fragment at the upper right of the text block; no legible running head, catchword or signature. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is excluded.
page.notes: The scan is almost entirely faded. Only dotted traces of about thirteen lines of print survive in the left column, and fainter traces appear in a central column. A small fragment at the upper right of the block may be a page number, but it cannot be read. No word could be reliably read, so every line is marked illegible and the letter counts are estimates. The line counts are approximate.
